reviews.title: Amazing purchase
reviews.comment:
I bought this a few months ago for my Girlfriend's PC, and she loves it. It was really easy to install, and so far it's working as expected, no overheating.
One thing she likes the most is the screen, which has good quality, even though it is small.
reviews.author: Jean Luis Jiménez

reviews.title: I approve!!!
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1-PwDvGIRL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71q5MkESKOL._SY256.jpg Drops Temp at a significant rate! reviews.comment: Great product. Needs better software though. Only complaint.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: It's a BIG boy
reviews.comment: The manual was a little confusion on how to install the cooler, took a little bit of trial and error. Temperature wise, it keeps my AM4 5900X at 65-70 degrees even under load. Have not run the benchmarks on it, but it stays at 70 or below when playing games. I recommend that you get a GPU sag bar to help support the weight of this thing, because its BIG and HEAVY. So far I am pleased with it.
reviews.author: JAT

reviews.title: Great CPU cooler and customizable display
reviews.comment: CPU cooler kept my CPU cool below normal range even when gaming. You could customize the display by uploading your video or picture. CPU and GPU temp are accurate. Just click settings in app. But get a separate thermal paste, even though it came with one.
reviews.author: Renald D
